title: Deepening foreign exchange opening-up to better serve China’s new development paradigm
body:
Keynote speech by Mr Zhu Hexin, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and SAFE Administrator, at the Annual Conference of Financial Street Forum 2026, Beijing, 19 October 2026.
